IF
UseStarted(_Player, S_UND_HiddenStash_Bag_fec2dad1-307e-4923-ba03-bef084116767)
AND
DB_Players(_Player)
AND
QRY_OnlyOnce("UND_Stopped_HiddenStashHighlight")
THEN
PROC_StopLoopEffect(S_UND_HiddenStash_Bag_fec2dad1-307e-4923-ba03-bef084116767, "UND_Hiddenstash_BagFlashing");
TimerCancel("UND_HiddenStash_Revealed");

PROC
PROC_UND_InjuredGnome_CheckIfHasCureAlready((CHARACTER)_Player)
AND
DB_Players((CHARACTER)_Player)
AND
QRY_ItemTemplateInMagicPockets(_Player, CONS_Potion_Antitoxin_f0c7d8bb-85e9-4937-96bb-49ba69d28631)
THEN
QuestUpdate(_Player, "UND_DuergarPoison", "FoundAntidote");

IF
Equipped(S_UND_MonkAmulet_Amulet_de2ea5a9-943a-4794-9ef7-208be7747178, _Player)
AND
DB_Players(_Player)
AND
QRY_UND_MonkAmulet_HasNoMadness(_Player)
THEN
SetFlag(UND_MonkAmulet_State_MinorMadness_f0ace28f-8b25-468b-b4ca-3e676ad22687, _Player, 0);

IF
DB_LOW_SteelWatchFoundry_DeadMansSwitches(_Baneite, _, _)
AND
_Baneite != NULL_00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
AND
GetItemByTemplateInInventory((ITEMROOT)QUEST_LOW_DeadMansSwitch_Shield_10d9e4a8-8019-47a9-88e3-dac74f7b8ae5, _Baneite, _EquipableSwitch)
THEN
SetCanBePickpocketed(_EquipableSwitch, 0);
